response.note: Attempt-level success rate for October 2026 (the current month); assumes the success status value is 'SUCCESS'.
response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_attempts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
